parameters.name: DeviceConfigs
parameters.description: The list of device configuration information.

sub_parameters.name: Content
sub_parameters.description:
The configuration content. You can pass in one of the following values:

- The configuration content text. For the format, see [Device configuration description](~~172319~~).
- The Object Storage Service (OSS) address where the configuration file is stored.

> You can specify up to 20 configurations in a single call.

sub_parameters.name: IotId
sub_parameters.description:
The device ID.

You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~) operation to query device IDs in the instance.

> You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
